title: 21. Projects: Naive Bayes - SMS Spam Detection
summary: This project demonstrates Naive Bayes for text classification using SMS Spam Collection dataset. Naive Bayes is highly effective for text classification tasks despite its "naive" independence assumption.
objectives: Build the Naive Bayes - SMS Spam Detection projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.body: This project demonstrates **Naive Bayes** for text classification using **SMS Spam Collection dataset**. Naive Bayes is highly effective for text classification tasks despite its "naive" independence assumption.

sections.title: Dataset
sections.body:
**SMS Spam Collection Dataset**

- **Samples**: 5,574 SMS messages
- **Features**: Raw text messages
- **Target Classes**:
  - Ham (legitimate): 4,827 messages (86.6%)
  - Spam: 747 messages (13.4%)
- **Average Message Length**: 80 characters
- **Imbalanced**: 1:6.5 spam-to-ham ratio

sections.title: Key Concepts Covered
sections.body:
### 1. Naive Bayes Fundamentals

- **Bayes Theorem**: P(A|B) = P(B|A) × P(A) / P(B)
- **Naive Independence Assumption**: Features are independent
- **Prior Probability**: P(spam) and P(ham)
- **Likelihood**: P(word|spam) and P(word|ham)
- **Posterior Probability**: P(spam|message)

### 2. Text Preprocessing Pipeline

- **Lowercasing**: Normalize text
- **Tokenization**: Split into words
- **Remove Punctuation**: Clean special characters
- **Remove Stopwords**: Filter common words (the, is, at)
- **Stemming/Lemmatization**: Reduce to root form
- **Remove Numbers**: Optional cleaning

### 3. Feature Engineering

- **Bag of Words**: Word frequency counts
- **TF-IDF**: Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency
- **N-grams**: Unigrams, bigrams, trigrams
- **Character N-grams**: Handle misspellings
- **Message Length**: Additional feature
- **Special Character Count**: Spam indicator

### 4. Naive Bayes Variants

- **Multinomial NB**: Word counts (best for text)
- **Bernoulli NB**: Binary word presence
- **Gaussian NB**: Continuous features (not ideal for text)
- **Complement NB**: Better for imbalanced data

### 5. Model Evaluation

- Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score
- Confusion Matrix
- ROC-AUC Score
- Precision-Recall Curve (imbalanced data)
- Cross-validation

sections.title: Expected Results
sections.body:
- **Multinomial NB Accuracy**: 97-98%
- **Precision (Spam)**: 95-97%
- **Recall (Spam)**: 92-94%
- **F1-Score**: 94-96%
- **ROC-AUC**: 0.97-0.98
- **Training Time**: < 1 second
- **Prediction Time**: Extremely fast

sections.title: Usage
sections.body:
### Quick Start (One Command)

```bash
cd 05_Naive_Bayes/src
python quick_start.py
```

### Step-by-Step Execution

1. **Data Preprocessing**:

```python
from data_preprocessing import SMSDataPreprocessor

preprocessor = SMSDataPreprocessor()
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = preprocessor.run_preprocessing_pipeline()
```

2. **Model Training**:

```python
from model_training import NaiveBayesTrainer

trainer = NaiveBayesTrainer()
best_model, results = trainer.run_complete_training()
```

3. **Azure Deployment**:

```bash
python deployment.py --workspace <workspace> --subscription <sub_id> --resource-group <rg>
```

sections.title: Key Takeaways
sections.body:
1. **Fast Training**: Naive Bayes trains almost instantly
2. **Memory Efficient**: Low memory footprint
3. **Probabilistic Output**: Natural probability estimates
4. **Works with Small Data**: Effective even with limited samples
5. **Handles High Dimensions**: TF-IDF creates thousands of features
6. **Baseline Model**: Often used as baseline for text classification

sections.title: Further Learning
sections.body:
- Laplace smoothing (add-one smoothing)

- Sentiment analysis applications
- Multi-class text classification

sections.title: Deployment
sections.body:
Model deployed as REST API endpoint on Azure ML:

- **Input**: SMS text message
- **Output**: Spam/Ham prediction with probability
- **Latency**: < 50ms
- **Compute**: Azure Container Instance (1 CPU, 0.5GB RAM)
- **Use Case**: Real-time spam filtering
